name: Midas mMEV
oneLiner: mMEV is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping MEV Capital's DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, and liquidation strategies; not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: MEV Capital-managed DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies allocated through Midas liquid-yield token rails.
pegMechanism: Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token with primary mint/redeem through Midas rails; it does not maintain a fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

oracleRisk.summary: mMEV is a NAV-accreting Midas Liquid Yield Token tracking a delta-neutral DeFi strategy; its underlying protocols can have liquidation risk, but mMEV is not itself a borrower CDP.

branchApplicability.rationale: Midas describes mMEV as a Liquid Yield Token for an MEV Capital-managed, delta-neutral strategy and separately identifies on-chain liquidation calls as one possible strategy activity. The reviewed product materials do not describe mMEV tokenholders opening borrower-owned debt positions or a token-level collateral threshold, liquidation engine, backstop, or shutdown branch; risks in underlying DeFi protocols are not an mMEV CDP branch to inventory under V9.

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mMEV is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mMEV is a Midas tokenized strategy token deployed on Ethereum, Plume, and Etherlink. Issuer docs show controlled product deployments but do not document a public third-party bridge, so the reviewed route is issuer-operated multichain issuance with probable lock/mint controls.

mintAuthority.summary: mMEV has independently mintable deployments on Ethereum, Plume, and Etherlink. A chain-local deposit vault and EOA 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 can mint on every deployment, while EOA 0x0383a2a62cd962a4780f615b5fa2a0ffc07ed1d2 is an additional Ethereum minter. Each chain's 1-of-3 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe and shared admin EOA can change those grants immediately; proxy upgrades pass through a two-day chain-local timelock.

routeChecks.signingModel: Each chain-local upgrade Safe is 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard. The owner sets differ by chain, so the failure-domain keys retain each Safe independently.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Every current ProxyAdmin is owned by a chain-local MidasTimelockController whose getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Each local Safe was the timelock's sole proposer, executor, and canceller; the delayed proxy-upgrade route is separate from immediate MidasAccessControl role administration.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, Plume block 80928370, and Etherlink block 48212139, every listed token, access-control, and deposit-vault transparent proxy resolved through its chain-local ProxyAdmin. ProxyAdmin ownership resolved to timelocks 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852, 0x2538325446dd80fc49830eea55d9e662b5acc35c, and 0x852c4f1beb54acb5360dbdba7ebbe9940a698f76. Each returned getMinDelay() = 172800 and assigned sole proposer, executor, and canceller authority to the corresponding chain-local 1-of-3 Safe.

review.evidence: Pinned chain state was reviewed at Ethereum 25527148, Plume 80928370, and Etherlink 48212139. M_MEV_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holders were: Ethereum EOAs 0x0383a2a62cd962a4780f615b5fa2a0ffc07ed1d2 and 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 plus vault 0xe092737d412e0b290380f9c8548cb5a58174704f; Plume EOA 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 plus vault 0xe6f0c60fca2bd97d633a3d9d49dbefdf19636d8c; Etherlink EOA 0x2facac0cda0225d7acca792821164b398c26bbd2 plus vault 0x577617613c4fac5a7561f8f3f2cb128a560774bc. Every chain also retained its local 1-of-3 Safe and shared EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 as immediate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders. All current mint-critical transparent proxies resolved through chain-local ProxyAdmins to two-day timelocks controlled by those local Safes.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Midas describes mMEV as tracking delta-neutral DeFi crypto yields under a stable-asset exposure mandate. Its documented same-underlying liquidity provision, statistical arbitrage, and carry trades are explicitly market-neutral, which fits the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype.
